quote: Nature doesn't judge; it simply is.
bio: Narivyl walks between two worlds: infernal blood and the living wild. They find balance where others see only conflict.

abilities.name: Produce Flame
abilities.effect: A flame in the palm that gives light like a torch and can be thrown. It only sets things alight with sustained contact.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.effect: On a hit, the target moves at half speed until its next action.

abilities.name: Speak with Beasts
abilities.effect: Talks with an animal. It answers with what an animal could know and cares about.

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.effect: Roots and vines burst from the ground and hold anyone who steps into the area. Requires earth or living matter.

abilities.name: Infernal Blood
abilities.effect: Resistance to fire. Sees in natural darkness out to medium range.

goal: Prove that blood doesn't decide whom the forest serves.
